Work in {project_root} on {date}. V747 ran nine producers and skipped five studies. Exp8709 failed with FileExistsError while collection reused private/0; no qualified learning union followed. Exp8712 proved lexical collisions on constructed worlds, not natural extraction. Exp8715 found 120 versus 130 defects using unequal probe counts. Exp8717 measured batching gain 1.138x, but same-batch B16 native/Python was 1.005x, not 10x. Exp8719 established exact compiled signed32/24 parity, not speed. CUDA repair is absent; no new ARC outcomes or physical acceleration were proved. Preserve historical results and qualifiers. V748 has exactly fourteen tasks, Exp8723 through Exp8736.

EXISTING CODE TO READ FIRST:
CLAUDE.md; CODEX.md; ops/e2e-test-plan.md; ops/exclusion_manifest.yaml; openspec/capabilities/research-reporting/spec.md; openspec/capabilities/verification/spec.md; scripts/experiment_template.py; python/carnot/reporting/primary_publication.py; openspec/change-proposals/research-roadmap-vNEXT.md; openspec/change-proposals/research-roadmap-v747-preserved-20261102.md; research-references.md; python/carnot/reporting/v747_capstone.py; results/experiment_8722_v747_capstone.json; scripts/publication_gate.py; scripts/summarize_artifact.py; ops/verifier_gaps.md; research-studying.md; ops/conductor-log.md

TASK:
Reconcile fourteen outcomes and close unchanged scientific questions. Deliver results/experiment_8736_v748_capstone.json. Use thin runner scripts/experiments/experiment_8736_v748_capstone.py, raw evidence results/raw/experiment_8736_v748_capstone/ and notes docs/research-notes/v748-capstone.md.

CONCRETE STEPS:
1. PRECONDITIONS: Print a flushed start line. Check exact input paths, source hashes, qualified producer receipts, tools, RAM and disk-backed private scratch before dependent work. A missing or disqualified external operand yields complete_blocked_<reason>, verdict_class=blocked and gate_check_summary with its path, hash, check, field and observed value. Missing differs from zero. Never fabricate a substitute or run a retired upstream.

2. Print a flushed progress line at EVERY phase boundary, before and after EVERY model load, generation, benchmark and subprocess that can take minutes. Use python -u or PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1, a parent heartbeat at least every 60 seconds while a child runs, and completed/pending lines INSIDE long loops. Keep every silence gap under 600 seconds; poll within 60 seconds. Write any file over about 200 lines in several tool calls of at most 150 lines, with a progress message between calls. No single tool call may contain a huge file. Stop measurement by 3600 seconds and reserve at least 900 seconds for checks within the 4800-second cap. Never pad duration.

3. Spec first: confirm relevant REQ-* requirements; extend specs and add failing focused tests before behavior changes. Reuse current helpers with a thin version binding instead of copying historical validation controllers. Freeze sources, tests, inputs and methods before execution. Keep original assertions, publication validators and historical result bytes intact. Put runners in scripts/experiments/, tests in tests/python/, scratch outside the repo; accept --date {date}.

4. Bind all fourteen complete task objects, visible table and canonical digest from the V748 design and staged/activated YAML as appropriate. Use the V748 table and original scientific methods as separate operands. Independently authenticate this branch; unrelated contract, CUDA or board readiness does not gate it. Reuse execution evidence only when its source, input, configuration and test identities are unchanged. A skip receipt is scheduling evidence, never a scientific measurement.

5. Declare inference_substrate_class=no_model_load; MODEL_SPECS=[]. Use aggregation_from_upstream_artifacts for readers, deterministic_verifier for constructed controls, or verifier_ensemble_against_cached_candidates for real small-head scoring. No LLM load or generation occurs.

6. Run after every scheduling slot without conductor gates. Reconcile all fourteen complete task objects, visible table, digest and dispositions, including this task. Distinguish producer executions, failed owned validation, pre-gate skip receipts and absent scientific measurements. Check every structured upstream field against the exact declared path and qualified producer.

7. Recompute continuous learning, retention, equal-budget verifier detection, Qwen support scoring, resident speed and installed attribution from admitted per-unit rows. Preserve constructed/oracle scope and exposed data, old batching gain, same-batch10x null, missing probabilities, CUDA block and physical limits. Do not let a positive readiness field imply a positive science result.

8. Run scripts/publication_gate.py --json and retain stable G1/G2/G3/G4, paper_ready and unmet_gates. Older publication readiness cannot certify new science. Record exact-repeat retirement candidates only after matching actual prior scope/verdict; state a specific changed-mechanism reopening condition for each failed branch. Never edit the exclusion manifest or automatically activate a future milestone.

9. Reconcile architecture, OpenSpec, traceability, status and changelog with every actual outcome. Report which next measurement can close a PRD gap and which unchanged questions should stop. External incompleteness is blocked, not partial; this reader must not consume three retries to describe the same missing input. No push, deployment or external publication.

10. Run focused unit tests, Ruff check/format, strict mypy on owned Python modules, scripts/check_spec_coverage.py --files <owned-test-files>, and the applicable private-output checks in ops/e2e-test-plan.md. New owned statements require 100 percent coverage including errors and subprocess paths. Retain actual child exits, node IDs, SQLite coverage, JUnit, source hashes and invocation clocks before scratch cleanup. Use bounded disjoint children with -n 0 -o addopts= --no-cov; killed children do not qualify. Do not run recursive historical controllers or the full repository test suite. A read-only task reuses existing tests and adds none for copied data.

11. Cold-replay final results from sealed primitives. Run unchanged primary publication validation, scripts/adversarial_verify.py --json <private-candidate> and scripts/verdict_row_consistency_lint.py --strict <private-candidate> before atomic publication. Reject consistently rehashed tampering and missing operands. Failed owned checks disqualify; unchanged external incompleteness is terminal blocked, never partial. Reconcile OpenSpec, _bmad/traceability.md, ops/status.md and ops/changelog.md with measured outcomes.

REQUIRED ARTIFACT FIELDS:
experiment_id, task_id, milestone, run_date, invocation_id: principle: Identify the actual task and run.
honest_verdict, verdict_class: principle: Start verdicts with complete_; use positive | circular_positive | null | blocked | disqualified | partial. Only incomplete owned work that a retry can finish is partial.
gate_check_summary: principle: Every blocked outcome records upstream, path/hash, check, field, operator, expected and observed values; external absence is not a measured zero.
inference_substrate, inference_substrate_class, MODEL_SPECS, model_invocation_counts: principle: Declare actual compute, including zero calls on blocked or model-free paths; no stale model names imply generation.
rows, intended_count, completed_count, failed_count, censored_count, excluded_count, independent_count: principle: Retain each intended unit and arm, numerator, denominator, status and cost so aggregates can be recomputed; seeds and repeats do not multiply independent cases.
verifier_is_oracle, exposure_scope, independent_generalization_score: principle: Constructed oracle-dependent positives are circular_positive; exposed data cannot establish independent generalization.
acceptance_gates, required_checks_passed, flagged_adversarial, validation_receipts, terminal_validation_sidecar_path: principle: Execution readiness differs from scientific benefit; failed acceptance gates forbid a positive class.
preconditions_checked, duration_s, started_at_utc, ended_at_utc, phase_spans, random_seed, reproducibility_checksum: principle: Retain real clocks and seeds; old monotonic epochs cannot measure a current invocation.
source_artifact_hashes, code_config_hashes, raw_shard_hashes, cited_upstream_artifacts, field_principles: principle: Bind imported fields and conclusions to exact evidence bytes, not mutable paths.
reconciliation_ready_score, task_outcome_rows, gate_edge_rows, retirement_candidate_rows, next_decision_rows, G1, G2, G3, G4, paper_ready, unmet_gates: principle: Complete terminal accounting preserves scientific gaps and fixed publication meanings.

Run command: cd {project_root} && JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu PYTHONPATH=python:. PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 .venv/bin/python -u scripts/experiments/experiment_8736_v748_capstone.py --date {date}

Do NOT push. Do NOT modify scripts/research_conductor.py.
